title: Borrower home - Polaris shell
kicker: render-strip kit adoption - real render, demo data
lede: Not hand-drawn. Both frames below are the actual PolarisHomeRouteView, the route the app opens after sign-in, hosting polaris_sdk's LoanScreen. Rendered headlessly to PNG at 390 logical px / dpr 3, with every numbered point placed automatically from the widget's measured rect.

labels.polaris.loan_screen: loan screen - borrower home (loan history, apply, status)
labels.polaris.apply_card: apply card - start a new loan application
labels.polaris.loan_status_card: loan status card - active or latest loan

notes.kicker: note - how these renders were produced
body: A widget-test harness (test/render/render_screen_test.dart); no app code touched. It pumps the real PolarisHomeRouteView, which initialises PolarisSDK itself in the demo session, and renders it at 390 logical px (dpr 3) at the full content height.

The data is the SDKs' own demo data. The test activates a demo session and the SDKs register their real repositories; base_sdk's DemoGatewayInterceptor answers them from polaris_sdk's and auth_sdk's own fixtures. The borrower is signed in through the real AuthRepositoryFacade.login.

Real fonts: Inter and Montserrat are the genuine files Google serves, committed under test/render/fonts/ and verified by google_fonts' own length and SHA-256 check. Remix and MaterialIcons come from the pub cache and the Flutter SDK cache.

notes.kicker: what these frames deliberately do NOT show
body: Loan history is NOT seeded. The loans store is written by the device as applications are made, so a widget test starts empty and the frame shows the genuine fresh-device state.
The brand palette is not applied in this harness. Polaris has no applyAppBrandColors import wired into the harness yet, so colours are the AppStyle defaults.
